stages.name: discovery
stages.note: 3 agents found the gateway's verified card

stages.name: decisions_match_policy
stages.note: 9 of 9 steps got the expected decision; every allowed step was executed and verified by Porch, no other step was executed

stages.name: hub_state_confirmed
stages.note: 11 of 11 hub reads matched the expected state

stages.name: owner_approval
stages.note: the request was held, the owner approved it through Porch, and the retry with the approval id was executed and verified

stages.name: unknown_agent_rejected
stages.note: Porch refused all 2 calls from an agent with no Porch key

stages.name: impersonation_blocked
stages.note: the request signed with the wrong key failed Town's signature check, never reached Porch, and the device did not change

stages.name: duplicate_applied_once
stages.note: 1 request was delivered twice by Town and Porch's audit log holds exactly one entry for it

stages.name: audit_complete
stages.note: 9 Porch audit entries match 9 adapter decisions by audit id, agent, request and decision

stages.name: ledger_conserved
stages.note: complete run recorded no money moved

stages.name: privacy
stages.note: no redaction declared by this scenario
